invariants: Every failed-command report prefers the first explicit error over preceding warnings or banners, otherwise retains the first meaningful line or the existing blank fallback.
The selected diagnostic remains one printable normalized line with no added length cap.
Diagnostic formatting cannot change delivery, persist correlation, restart eligibility, lifecycle actions, outcome classification or exit status.
The validation handoff identifies every affected caller and inspected unchanged axis, distinguishing fixture evidence from live proof.

lifecycle_and_guards: Persist success still records the correlation and waits for the matching reply; unanswered or failed requests retain the fallback path without relaunch.
A failed send can follow durable inbox publication; selecting its error does not prove the message was absent or undo existing inbox work.
Nudge success increments nudged; nudge failure increments unreached and formats its independent diagnostic.
Local and remote relaunch success still report restarted before the failure formatter is reached; failed relaunch and spawn-collision outcomes retain their existing classifications.
Background-shell cleanup, capability/profile/account refusals, per-mate locks, asynchronous result harvesting and restart exit statuses are unchanged.
No action against q-server or inbox1922/1923 was performed; preserving their durable work and deferring restart remain operational acceptance constraints.

regression_oracle.source: Author intent requires underlying failures instead of banners; accepted R1 requires printable single-line normalization, existing fallbacks, no added truncation and preserved native persist/no-restart semantics.
owned_state_contracts: SSH command log records whether relaunch was attempted; pending replies and steering inboxes use the real project implementations inside fixtures.
wrong_behaviors_rejected: Reporting a banner instead of the persist or nudge error
Relaunching after the fixture persist send fails
regression_oracle.limits: The removed cap-only case is not replaced with a source-text assertion. The remaining cases do not independently prove arbitrarily long diagnostics or every control character.

gaps: No live harness, installed vendor version, authenticated account, real SSH transport or q-server state was verified by these review rounds.
Existing live signal guards are prerequisites, not complete end-to-end diagnostic-failure proof across every harness/backend/platform combination.
Local formatter routing is inspected; new diagnostic failure fixtures exercise remote routing. Other retained local lifecycle tests do not establish every local diagnostic form.

The actual 09:12Z inbox1922/1923 incident was not replayed; tests demonstrate representative banner/error ordering only, without touching its durable work.
